shared_elements: upright rectangular slab with carved figural relief on one face
rows of repeated small motifs (signs / zigzag or chevron band)
low relief with flat raised surfaces and incised interior detail
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low relief organised into an upper figural field and lower horizontal bands filled with rows of small repeated motifs, and both include human figures and profile creatures rendered schematically. But the content differs sharply: A shows two clothed human figures facing each other in an offering scene above lines of standardised script signs, while B shows a menagerie of animals (quadrupeds, a bird, a serpentine form), a row of arch-like shapes and a squatting figure with no facing pair and no writing.
